cli.--threads: N > 0 selects the MT run manager; absent = Serial (default). Each thread adds a full copy of the chemistry state, so memory grows with N.
cli.--dir: redirects every output file into <path>; the parent must already exist, the leaf is created

smoke.note: Write a scratch macro into <runBuildDir>/macro (untracked). Do not edit macro/beam.in (100 keV, 1 s end time by default: long). For a quick run issue '/scheduler/endTime 1 ms' after /run/initialize. End the macro with '/run/dumpDataAndReset' (no prefix) so the files in run.outputs are produced with their bare names -- omitting it falls back to the EndOfRun_-prefixed safety-net dump at process exit instead.

outputs: PreChemical_run<R>_event<E>.txt (one per event, moved into the Dump)

test.validation: every test Passed and none Not Run
test.wiring: add_executable(<X>Test test/<X>Test.cc src/<cluster>/<X>.cc [src deps]) + target_link_libraries(... ${Geant4_LIBRARIES}) + add_test(NAME <X>Test COMMAND <X>Test)
test.scope: pure logic only, no Geant4 kernel. Geant4-object code (scorers, actions, reaction tables) is verified by the smoke run.
